claim: OpenTelemetry metrics in CloudWatch are ingested with OTLP and queried with PromQL; the model supports up to 150 labels per data point and includes 15 months of storage with no per-metric charges.
question: What do OpenTelemetry metrics in CloudWatch support, and how long is storage included?

values.display: up to 150 labels per data point

qualifiers.condition: Classic metrics support up to 30 dimensions per metric with per-metric-per-month pricing.

evidence.quote: OpenTelemetry metrics in CloudWatch use the OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP) for ingestion and PromQL for querying. This model supports open-source metric names, up to 150 labels per data point, and includes 15 months of storage with no per-metric charges.

note: Query Studio with PromQL went generally available on 2026-06-15 (cloudwatch-change-query-studio-ga-2026-06). Do not rewrite classic PutMetricData facts as OTel facts.

claim: With log file integrity validation enabled, CloudTrail creates and delivers a digest file every hour that references the log files of the last hour and contains a hash of each.
question: How often does CloudTrail deliver digest files when log file integrity validation is enabled?

qualifiers.scope: trails with log file integrity validation

evidence.quote: Every hour, CloudTrail also creates and delivers a file that references the log files for the last hour and contains a hash of each. This file is called a digest file.
